lines: Staff can now find any member, by name, by email, or by their standing in the community.
The Members page lists everyone, newest first. Each row shows name and email, home church, the day they joined in Toronto, events, and status.
Active, Flagged and Suspended are tabs. Each is a link, so the address names what is on screen.
Search waits for the last key, then asks once. It looks in names and emails, never in a home church.
When nobody matches, the page says so, and Clear search brings everyone back.
Twenty-five members fill a page. The pages keep the tab and the search, and a new page moves focus to the table.
While members load, rows hold their place. If they do not load, Try again asks again.
On the server, one answer holds the page, the matches, and the size of the community. Nothing staff search for is ever logged.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Later, staff flag, suspend and reinstate.
That's slice twenty-six point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
